decisions.display_source: Unchanged raw master with display-only white/cyan matte and nearest alpha; never game payload.
decisions.reason: Actually compared returned repair with exact original on source/white/cyan/alpha page. The original requested neck correction is still visibly incomplete. The returned head remains extended down into a long tapered yellow throat/upper-body column inside a narrow human-sized open blue shirt V. Redraw a compact near-round head with a real curved chin and VERY SHORT BROAD neck/upper-chest transition; fit shoulder lines and the actual open shirt collar circumference to the mascot. Keep the genuine open neckline and exposed yellow upper chest, without adding undershirt/bib, closing buttons or leaving a long yellow stalk. Preserve actual close curly dark hair, smooth face, pale-blue open shirt and its real buttons, source gaze/expression/lighting/crop and restored opaque painted backdrop.
